quality_boundary: This Phase 14 inventory verifies Kawagoe's new fifth comprehensive plan, rolling 2026-2028 implementation plan, FY2026 initial-budget route, and FY2024 historical settlement route. It explicitly preserves the old-plan/current-plan boundary and does not infer current achievement, fiscal causality, or cross-city comparability.
